hook_text: Half a kilometre: 50 metres or 500 metres? One of them is a very short fun run.
clip_script: Knysna, planning a 5 km fun run. 1 km is 1 000 m, so 5 km is 5 000 m. Smaller unit, bigger number: multiply. Half a kilometre? Half of 1 000: 500 m. A quarter: 250 m. Route sections: 1 km 750 m and 2 and 1/2 km. Change both to metres: 1 750 plus 2 500 is 4 250. The last section: 5 000 minus 4 250, 750 m. Medal ribbon: 6 m is 600 cm, cut into 25 cm pieces: 24 medals. Same unit first, every time.
visual_style: A route map along a lagoon with distance labels switching units, then ribbon being cut into equal pieces.
mood: Bright and outdoorsy, like a run along the water on a sunny morning.
pacing: Quick facts, the half-kilometre twist, then the route and ribbon problems.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and measure a route around your school in metres and kilometres.
